blocks.text: Birchland Manor Houses: the housing stock

items.t: The stock is detached houses on the Fraser Avenue and Prairie Avenue streets of a small pocket, under the City's RS zones in Zoning Bylaw No. 3630: minimum lot width is 15 metres in RS1, 12 metres in RS2, 30 metres in RS3 and 9.5 metres in RS4.
Terry Fox Secondary, at 1260 Riverwood Gate, sits north of the pocket in Riverwood, the secondary school named for this side of the city.

blocks.text: Birchland Manor Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Port Coquitlam's small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) rules allow 3 to 6 units on RS lots without rezoning, depending on lot size, location and transit access.
Port Coquitlam is inside the speculation and vacancy tax taxable area, so residential owners here must declare each year.

blocks.text: Birchland Manor Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The pocket is small enough that its school and its bus loop are its two landmarks: Birchland Elementary on Fraser Avenue inside it, and the 173/174 loop at Prairie Avenue and Coast Meridian Road on its west edge.
The secondary school named for this side of the city, Terry Fox Secondary, is in the neighbouring Riverwood pocket to the north, not inside Birchland Manor.
The board does not publish the sub-area's boundary roads, so two houses on the same street can fall on different sides of the board line.

blocks.text: Birchland Manor Houses: costs and taxes

items.t: Port Coquitlam property taxes were due July 2, 2026, with a 5 percent penalty after July 2 and a further 5 percent after September 15, 2026, and the City's 2026 increase was 1.95 percent for the average home.
The City states it has the lowest average property taxes and utility fees in Metro Vancouver, and utilities are flat annual water and sewer fees billed separately from taxes, due March 31, 2026.
Coast Meridian Road is the pocket's west edge and its route south to Lougheed Highway over the Coast Meridian Overpass, and Prairie Avenue is its east–west street.
The 173 and 174 bus loop at Prairie Avenue and Coast Meridian Road is the pocket's transit anchor.

blocks.text: Birchland Manor Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Confirm the RS zone and its minimum lot width for the specific lot in Zoning Bylaw No. 3630, because RS1 through RS4 carry different widths from 9.5 to 30 metres.
Confirm the SD43 catchment for the exact address in the district locator, since the pocket's elementary school being inside the pocket does not by itself settle the middle and secondary assignments.
